items.prompt: 补写 2—3 句，说明为什么图书馆适合学习。至少使用 because。
items.starter: I often study in the library.
items.reference: I often study in the library because it provides a quiet place. I can focus on my work and finish it more efficiently.
checklist: 是否使用 because 连接原因

items.prompt: 用 2—3 句写一项课程的困难和好处，至少使用 but。
items.reference: The course is demanding, but it gives me many opportunities to practise. As a result, I understand the subject better.
checklist: but 前后是否形成真实转折
是否写出课程带来的好处

items.prompt: 给同学写一条短消息：说明你会晚到、给出原因，并告诉对方先做什么。
items.starter: Hi Chen, I will be late
items.reference: Hi Chen, I will be late because my bus has stopped in traffic. Please start the meeting without me. I should arrive before seven.
checklist: 是否告诉对方先做什么
